assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production transparent game scenery sprite atlas for netKonnect.
Primary request: SIX horizontal road-surface strips on a GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background, one strip per row, precise equal-height SIX-ROW ONE-COLUMN atlas. Canvas landscape 3:2. Each row occupies exactly one sixth of canvas height with generous transparent gutters separating rows. Each strip extends nearly entire canvas width, begins and ends as straight clean vertical cuts for horizontal stretching; NO rounded end caps, NO perspective convergence, no depth recession. Render original art, not a design sheet.
Style: sophisticated watercolor wash with fine navy ink edges, sage grass, warm ochre and pale stone, understated European illustrated landscape, handpainted textured material. Shallow elevated SIDE ELEVATION looking over a narrow road top, with thin front edge at bottom. Every road edge and wheel-contact baseline completely level and horizontal across full width. No objects above road travel plane.
Rows TOP TO BOTTOM:
1. Dirt road: warm ochre earth, two fine wagon ruts running horizontally, sage grassy shoulders, a few tiny verge wildflowers.
2. Gravel road: muted beige-gray compacted gravel, delicately stippled stones, low grass shoulders, very shallow crushed-stone front edge, no painted markings.
3. Single-lane paved road: narrow muted slate-gray asphalt top, pale gravel shoulders, white edge lines only, no central dashed markings.
4. Boulevard: wider two-lane asphalt top, thin cream dashed separator horizontal, pale stone curb edges, restrained grass verge outside curb; no trees, no furniture.
5. Small highway: wider two-lane smooth cool-gray pavement, horizontal dashed lane divider, thin edge lines, very low gray guardrail along bottom front edge ONLY below the road surface; no median objects.
6. Large highway: broad three-lane cool-gray surface with TWO parallel horizontal dashed lane dividers, edge lines and low stone/metal barrier just below front edge; slight sage shoulders, understated.
Materials continuous from left to right; all six strips are similarly narrow top-surface ribbons centered in their cells, occupying roughly middle half of each row height; grass and front edges no taller than a few pixels relative to strip. Clear 35% row-height transparent separation between each strip. Consistent soft daylight.
Constraints: ONLY these six terrain strips. NO vehicles, people, buildings, water, sky, signposts, lamps, trees, labels, lettering, numbers, panel frames, captions, checkerboard baked into pixels, white/colored paper background, drop shadow beneath whole atlas or watermark. Alpha transparency outside isolated strips. Orthographic lateral terrain, never isometric. Six strips only.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production transparent scenery sprite atlas, netKonnect multimodal corridors.
Primary request: THREE straight horizontal transport-surface strips, equal THREE-ROW ONE-COLUMN atlas, landscape 3:2. Only isolated scenery with GENUINE ALPHA TRANSPARENCY outside the strips. Each row one third canvas height, strip nearly entire canvas width with clean vertically cut left/right ends and generous transparent gutters. Narrow top surfaces in shallow elevated SIDE ELEVATION, orthographic, every route edge horizontal across full width; no vanishing point.
Style: finely drawn navy ink over textured watercolor, sage grassy verge, pale ivory stone, understated European landscape. Match the previously generated road strips. Daylight.
TOP ROW: single horizontal railway track on warm gravel ballast, two narrow steel rails, small brown timber sleepers in shallow top view, low grassy shoulders. NO trains, overhead poles, tunnels or bridges.
MIDDLE ROW: navigable blue-water canal, long clean horizontal strip of softly rippled watercolor water with fine pale highlights, low pale-stone retaining bank along the back edge and very shallow grassy/stone front edge below water; ship waterline travels horizontally near center. NO boats, docks, cranes, buildings or trees. The water surface occupies at least 70% of strip height.
BOTTOM ROW: airport runway, long horizontal dark slate tarmac strip with cream dashed center line and runway markings parallel to travel direction, fine white edge stripes and tiny amber edge lights below front edge, short grassy shoulders. NO aircraft, numbers, lettering or signs.
Constraints: three strips only, centered within their cells, no paper background, no sky, people, vehicles, animals, labels, panel borders, shadows around sheet, or watermark. Alpha transparency preserved. All top surfaces uniform width left to right, NOT isometric. No landscape background.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: netKonnect production transparent game scenery, two airport growth sprites in one atlas.
Primary request: TWO small airport/spaceport buildings, exact TWO COLUMNS ONE ROW, equal cells, generous clear transparent gutter. Canvas landscape 3:2. True SIDE ELEVATION with shallow top surfaces and almost no depth, compatible with orthographic side-profile aircraft moving horizontally. Each complex grounded on identical LEVEL baseline in lower quarter of cell; all buildings complete within its cell. Buildings and low apron only, GENUINE ALPHA TRANSPARENCY outside painted structures.
LEFT CELL: welcoming regional cargo airport terminal, low ivory stone terminal with soft blue arched glazing, terracotta/gray curved roof, modest navy/ivory control tower to one side, a few cargo crates at far edge, small sage bushes, very narrow level pale gray apron beneath it. Human scale, simple coherent silhouette.
RIGHT CELL: optimistic advanced city spaceport terminal, pale ivory architecture, elegant blue-glass arched hangar, slightly taller slender control tower, a small communications dish and sage planted roof, subtle warm terracotta accents, level pale gray apron beneath it. Clear technological growth but same illustrated visual family; NO rocket and no airborne vehicles.
Style/medium: finely outlined navy ink with hand-painted watercolor texture, ivory architecture, blue glass, sage greenery, quiet terracotta accents, charming sophisticated European landscape illustration, clean readable at 60 pixels wide.
Lighting: consistent soft daylight, restrained architectural shadows.
Constraints: exactly two isolated building groups, no planes, ships, vehicles, people, runways crossing entire sheet, sky, landscape, paper background, lettering, numbers, logos, signs, caption labels, frame, watermark. Not isometric, not photorealistic, not 3D render. Preserve generous transparent margins and gutter.
